name: trivial_2x2
description: Trivial 2x2 SDP: max x_11 s.t. x_11=1, X>=0. Optimal X*=diag(1,0) is SINGULAR (rank-deficient boundary optimum). Tests that the solver handles PSD-boundary cases (CLAUDE.md invariant 1).

known_gaps.reason: adaptive returns ADAPTIVE_OPTIMAL at final_prec=128 (no escalation) but the recovered objective midpoint is only ~6.7 digits vs target 12: the 6-flag inner tolerance (1e-12) passes on scaled residuals while the point-mode objective recovery at 128 bits is precision/conditioning-limited near the singular X*=diag(1,0) boundary. p68 (controller must validate objective accuracy / set prec floor from target_digits); root cause shared with b30 (cone safety).

at the natural escalation ceiling (target_digits=30 forces escalation to 1024 bits for 14.2 objective digits) the cost is ~72 bits/digit, far above the 8 b/d goal; the b30 PSD-boundary brittleness (NUM at 128/256/512) is the driver.
